data.one_liner: An atomic dependency and state management toolkit for Dart and Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Nucleus provides an atomic model for managing application state and dependencies. It allows creating simple state atoms, derived atoms, async future/stream atoms, and features built-in support for families and storage persistence.
use_when: You want a lightweight, atomic state management and dependency injection system.
You need automatic disposal and lazy initialization of states.
You want to easily derive state from other atoms or handle futures/streams reactively.
avoid_when: You prefer established massive ecosystem packages like Provider, Riverpod, or Bloc.
You want compile-time code generation for atoms.
strengths: Built-in support for future, stream, and persisted storage atoms
Automatic disposal and lazy loading of atoms
weaknesses: Smaller community and ecosystem compared to Riverpod or Bloc
Less documentation for advanced use cases like writableAtom
data.setup_notes: Simply add flutter_nucleus or nucleus to pubspec.yaml. Wrap your app in AtomScope if using initial values like shared preferences.

alternatives.name: riverpod
alternatives.why_pick_it: Riverpod is a more mature and widely adopted atomic state management library with a very similar conceptual model.

alternatives.name: provider
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provider is a standard, simple dependency injection and state management solution built on InheritedWidget.

alternatives.name: bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: BLoC provides strict unidirectional data flow and event-driven state management for larger applications.
